items.title: Over a locally Noetherian algebraic stack, locally of finite type implies locally of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian target is locally of finite presentation, and that the same holds with finite type and quasi-separated replaced by finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 5655-5664, label lemma-noetherian-finite-type-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 5666-5680) reduces to a presentation square, applies the corresponding statement for schemes to the presenting morphism, reads the conclusion back by definition, and derives the second part from the first through quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness (proof lines 5668-5680). The reduction through the presentation and the passage from (1) to (2) are the content. H2.
